name: Squarespace
description: Squarespace is a website-builder platform ("A website makes it real") that lets people create, customize, and manage a website alongside integrated business tools like ecommerce, scheduling, and invoicing — without coding.
best_for: Squarespace positions itself for entrepreneurs, freelancers, creatives, and small business owners across industries (beauty, fitness, real estate, nonprofits, education, professional services) who want a website plus built-in business operations tools.

alternatives.name: Wix
alternatives.description: A drag-and-drop website builder with hosting and ecommerce built in.
alternatives.best_for: Small business owners wanting an accessible free-to-start site builder.

alternatives.name: WordPress
alternatives.description: An open-source, block-based publishing platform extensible via plugins and themes.
alternatives.best_for: Users wanting maximum customization and self-hosting control.
